name: pkg_lifecycle_statuses
title: The lifecycle status of each function in an installed package.

origin.description: The lifecycle status of each function in an installed package.
origin.details: Reads the installed help topics, keeps the lifecycle token in each description, and returns package, function, and status.
origin.value: The same rows R returns for lifecycle.
origin.example:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(lifecycle))
show <- function(df) if (!nrow(df)) "EMPTY" else paste(df$fun, df$lifecycle, sep="=", collapse=",")
cat(paste(show(pkg_lifecycle_statuses("lifecycle")), show(pkg_lifecycle_statuses("lifecycle", which=c("deprecated", NA))), show(pkg_lifecycle_statuses("lifecycle", which="questioning")), sep=" || "))
